title: STP in One Flow Explained Simply | Marketing Management Ep 12
description:
Laddoo Lab now has three kinds of customers: gym-goers who want protein, office workers who want a desk snack, and parents who want a healthy tiffin sweet. One small kitchen cannot serve them all. In this animated lesson, Zoya puts segmentation, targeting and positioning together into one flow, the STP framework.

You will see what each of the three words means, Kotler and Armstrong's two questions of marketing strategy, and where the ideas came from: Wendell R. Smith on market segmentation in 1956, and Al Ries and Jack Trout, who made positioning famous in 1972. Then we watch the whole flow live: sixty survey answers sorted into groups, each group scored on size, growth and fit, and one target chosen. A positioning map shows the empty gap Laddoo Lab moves into, and Zoya writes her positioning statement in one sentence. We also see STP at work today in a bank, an airline, a food delivery app and a phone maker, and the honest trade-off: focus saves money and makes the message clear, but groups can be too small and labels can box people in.

This is Episode 12 of our Marketing Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.
